name: ProjectSpecificRestriction
summary: The card component of Project Specific Restriction (DUO_0000027). The requester's project is one the owner approved and has an intended use, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs a DataUseConditionCredential about the requester.

approvedProjects.description: Project DIDs for which access is allowed; compared with the subject of each IntendedDataUseCredential. If the key is missing, no IDU qualifies and access is denied.
